_note: SCAFFOLD — not a declaration. `manamap pilot scaffold-targets` derived these groups from contained combo lines and role axes; every label is a PLACEHOLDER and every group is a starting point to edit, not a finding. A goldfish group is a deck-specific functional set ("the metronome bodies", "the flash traps"), which is a different thing from a role: `ROLE_PATTERNS` answers what job a card does in any 99. Nothing here names a WIN LINE, because a machine guessing at one manufactures the exact claim `validate-goldfish-targets` exists to demand. Rewrite the labels, regroup the members, add the line this deck actually wins with, then run `manamap pilot validate-goldfish-targets <slug>` and delete "scaffolded".
